title: Nayirah Testimony
excerpt: PR firm coached the Kuwaiti ambassador's daughter to give fake testimony about baby murders — helped justify the Gulf War.
excerptEs: Firma de PR preparó a la hija del embajador kuwaití para dar testimonio falso sobre asesinatos de bebes — ayudó a justificar la Guerra del Golfo.

sources.title: Human Rights Watch Gulf War report
